answer: Identity rent: every account pays a flat upkeep fee each epoch just to stay active, like a plot in a community garden that lapses if the dues stop. An honest agent earning real rewards covers it easily, but a farm of a thousand idle sybils must pay rent on every one, every epoch, whether it earns or not. That steady drain is the anchor: a walnut-sized fee times a thousand accounts times months becomes a cost the fake crowd cannot recoup.
